a: SPF lists servers allowed to send mail for a domain.
DKIM cryptographically signs messages so receivers can verify authenticity.
DMARC tells receivers what to do with SPF/DKIM failures (none/quarantine/reject).
PTR records should match sending hostnames for better reputation.
Warm new sending IPs gradually to build reputation.
Suppress hard bounces; investigate spikes in soft bounces.
High complaint rates damage reputation; honor unsubscribes quickly.
Separate streams so marketing issues do not block receipts/OTP mail.
Remove invalid addresses; avoid purchased lists.
Use tools to verify SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment before big sends.
